info.name: MetroMatrix — Chunk 4 (Food Court)
info.description:
Discover → cart (option rules, one vendor) → preview (delivery fee is the only fee) → checkout (idempotent, PIZZA20) → kitchen (accept, prepare, ready, assign) → rider (steps, location, delivered, cash, handover) → review, reorder, insights, plan → staff.

Needs: migrated DB, `npm run seed:superadmin`, `npm run seed:food` (SEED_DEMO_PASSWORD), Mailpit. Run with `npm run postman:food` (passes adminPassword and demoPassword from env; never stored here). When the demo vendor is closed, the order is scheduled for half an hour after it opens — every step still runs. Realtime events are checked by `npm run socket:food`.

item.name: Preview: the delivery fee is the only fee

exec: pm.test('Preview: the delivery fee is the only fee → 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('subtotal, discount, delivery fee, total — nothing else', () => pm.expect(Object.keys(d.totals).sort()).to.eql(['deliveryFee', 'discount', 'subtotal', 'total']));
pm.test('the code applies (20% of the pizza, rounded down)', () => pm.expect(d.deal).to.include({ code: 'PIZZA20', discount: Math.floor(1130 * 0.2) }));
pm.test('the deal is on the order', () => pm.expect(d.deal.code).to.eql('PIZZA20'));
pm.test('Checkout replay (same key → same order) → 201', () => pm.response.to.have.status(201));

pm.test('pickup, drop and cash to collect', () => { pm.expect(o.pickup.name).to.eql('Sahil Tikka & Pizza Oven'); pm.expect(o.drop.riderInstructions).to.eql('Gate 2, call on arrival'); pm.expect(o.cashToCollect).to.eql(o.total); });
pm.test('Picked up → on the way → 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('Customer: tracking shows the rider → 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('rider with a live location', () => pm.expect(d.rider).to.include({ name: 'Asif Baloch', locationLive: true }));
pm.test('the COD is on my ledger', () => pm.expect(d.entries.some((e) => e.kind === 'cod_collected' && e.orderCode === pm.collectionVariables.get('orderCode'))).to.be.true);

item.name: Vendor: rider hands the cash over

exec: pm.test('Vendor: rider hands the cash over → 200', () => pm.response.to.have.status(200));
pm.test('can review and reorder', () => { pm.expect(d.canReview).to.be.true; pm.expect(d.canReorder).to.be.true; });
pm.test('every rider step is an event', () => pm.expect(d.events.filter((e) => e.kind === 'rider').map((e) => e.to)).to.include.members(['assigned', 'picked_up', 'delivered']));
pm.test('replied', () => pm.expect(d.vendorReply).to.eql('Thank you! See you again.'));
pm.test('recorded, not earnings', () => pm.expect(d.note).to.match(/holds none of it/));
pm.test('one brand, one branch', () => pm.expect(d.limits).to.include({ brands: 1, branches: 1 }));
